Order kaise hota hai

Aaj The Cake Boutique ke saare orders Instagram DM aur phone se hote hain — koi menu, flavour list ya order form online nahi hai. Is demo me wahi process teen steps me dikhaya gaya hai:

01

Lookbook dekho

Upar sample designs dekho aur apne occasion ke hisaab se style pasand karo — birthday, wedding, kids ya fusion.

02

Enquiry banao

Neeche apna naam, flavour, size aur date chuno — tumhara ready-made message khud ban jayega.

03

WhatsApp par bhejo

Message copy karke ya seedha WhatsApp button se shop ko bhej do. Price aur design shop confirm karega — har cake price on enquiry hai.

Custom Cake Enquiry

Apni details chuno, message taiyaar ho jayega. Flavours sample options hain — asli menu shop phone par confirm karega.
